declarations.description: A card that groups an image, a header, a description, and a call to action into one summary of information, such as a destination, offer, or article teaser. **Key capabilities** - **Content areas**: four named slots (`image`, `header`, `description`, `cta`) that you fill with your own content. - **Clickable card**: setting `href` makes the whole card a single link, built on ``, including its safe handling of URLs. - **Spacing options**: set `variant` to `inset-content`, `inset-container`, or `inset-stretch` to choose how padding is applied around the image and text. - **Border and alignment**: `border` adds an outline with rounded corners, and `center` centers the text. **Example** ```html Hawaii Fly nonstop from the West Coast. ```

members.name: border
members.description: Adds a thin border and rounded corners around the card.

members.name: center
members.description: Centers the text within the card.

members.name: href
members.description: Makes the whole card a single link to an address such as `/destinations/hawaii` (the [`auro-hyperlink`](https://auro.alaskaair.com/components/auro/hyperlink/api#href) `href` attribute), including its safe handling of URLs. Because the card's content is rendered inside the link, avoid placing other links or buttons in the card's slots.

members.name: register

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: The tag name to register the element under.

members.description: Registers the element with the browser under a tag name. Use a custom name to run this version alongside another version of `auro-card` on the same page.

members.name: rel
members.description: Sets how the linked page relates to this one, such as `noopener` or `nofollow` (the [`auro-hyperlink`](https://auro.alaskaair.com/components/auro/hyperlink/api#rel) `rel` attribute).

members.name: relative
members.description: Passes a `relative` attribute to the [`auro-hyperlink`](https://auro.alaskaair.com/components/auro/hyperlink/api). The auro-hyperlink version this card uses does not currently act on it, so it has no visible effect.

members.name: role
members.description: Sets the card's accessibility role. Without `href`, the role is `article`. With `href`, the value is passed to the [`auro-hyperlink`](https://auro.alaskaair.com/components/auro/hyperlink/api#role), and no role is set when it is empty.

members.name: setRole
members.description: Sets the role attribute for the component.

members.name: target
members.description: Sets where the link opens, such as `_blank` for a new tab or `_self` for the current tab (the [`auro-hyperlink`](https://auro.alaskaair.com/components/auro/hyperlink/api#target) `target` attribute).

Sets how padding is applied. Use `inset-content` to pad the text and leave the image edge to edge, `inset-container` to pad the whole card, image included, or `inset-stretch` to let the image and text reach the left and right edges, with space above the image and below the text. Without a value, the card adds no extra left, right, or top padding. When `href` is set, the text always gets left and right padding, even with `inset-stretch`.
